agent_report.summary: Fixed the Commitments add-form button stretch (root-caused via `align-items: flex-start` on `.add-form`, replacing default `stretch`) and, per the Queen's expanded scope, the shared text-input collapse that truncated pt-BR placeholders in the two-column Priorities/Tasks panels (`.add-form input` now has a `160px` floor instead of `min-width: 0`, with time/date pickers explicitly reset to `min-width: 0` so they keep their small fixed size). Also renamed the non-today eyebrow from "Vendo" to "Visualizando" and made every screenshot test scroll to the top before capturing, updating the affected test assertions. All 80 Playwright tests pass; verified layout numerically and visually. Opened PR #32 (branch `ant/issue-22`) closing Issue #22.
